newsitem.title: UK: Soft oils steady, palm lower on European market.
newsitem.headline: Soft oils steady, palm lower on European market.

text.p: Soft oil prices on the European vegetable oil market were supported by the higher close in Chicago overnight and a firmer dollar on Thursday.

Palm oil fell despite a late rally on Malaysian markets but business remained quiet ahead of the end-year holidays and release on Friday of Ivan Wong's latest crop report and export data for the first 20 days of December from cargo surveyor SGS.
"At this time of year it's any excuse to do nothing," said a trader.
Business over the next few days is expected to be limited to position-squaring.
"People are only squaring positions ahead of the holiday, the market is getting quieter and quieter," said another trader.
Dutch soy oil sellers were 0.50 guilders up at midday while rape oil was 0.25 to 0.50 guilders higher with no business reported so far.
Based on sellers' prices the premium for rape oil over soyoil was 0.50 to three guilders at midday, against 2.25 to three guilders at Wednesday's close.
Crude palm oil cif Europe was mixed at $5 down to $2.50 up while refined oils were unchanged to $2.50 lower.
Olein traded at $567.50 for Jan and $555 a tonne fob Malaysian ports for Apr/Jun.
Lauric oils were mixed with coconut oil $2.50 to $5 lower and palmkernel oil $5 to $12.50 up in neglected markets.
